text.都心の利便性と、多忙なご夫婦の寛ぎを兼ね備えた、ヴィンテージマンションの上質リフ: A fine vintage apartment renovation that holds together the convenience of the city and the ease of a busy couple. At the entrance an Oya stone wall and a low niche receive a visitor, and give a place for a scroll or whatever else one cares to put out. Natural materials — reddish solid padauk flooring, lime plaster on walls and ceilings — make a space with a lustre and a calm one would not expect in the middle of the city, and a latticed sliding door in the living room gives it a Japanese air.
text.15ミリの厚さがあり、1.8mの長さのある無垢カリンを使用。天然オイルで仕上げて: Solid padauk 15 mm thick in 1.8 m lengths, finished in natural oil; with time the colour and the sheen deepen.
